test_only_reason: Closes acceptance gaps of P3-INTERVAL-MIN: the four split-findmin implementations already exist; these tests pin the Q-14 interval-id contract used by Evaluate and the Q-16 key-increase rule without changing the implementation
spec: After a successful split both sides get fresh ids (2s-1, 2s), the old id is never returned again, other intervals keep their ids, decreases/queries/rejected splits change no id, and a stored (sample, id) handle is current iff its interval was not split since; decrease to an equal key is a no-op, decrease to a larger key aborts with assertions and leaves the structure unchanged under NDEBUG

events.command: bash -c 'cmake --build --preset debug && ctest --preset debug -R "Q-14|Q-16" && ctest --preset debug'
